If After gets the original ctx, the log file handle will never be closed, which can break temp-dir cleanup (notably on Windows) and leak descriptors. Consider storing the opened log file in a package-level var (similar to profiling's `activeSession`) and have `closeLogger` close that instead of reading from context.

`initLogger` opens `logFile` later in the function; if a subsequent error path is taken (e.g., `os.Setenv(OTELC_DEBUG, "1")` failing when `--debug` is set), the function returns without closing the opened file descriptor. This is a real FD leak on an error path; close `logFile` before returning from that Setenv failure branch.
